question_ids.title: Question Ids

ExtractionTaskJustification.description: Untrusted extraction hint; empty reasons are audited and dropped before storage.
ExtractionTaskJustification.title: ExtractionTaskJustification

MediationDraft.description: Wire contract separates need treatment, source-backed additions and review questions.

parent_revision_ids.title: Parent Revision Ids

NeedSpanObservation.description: Current provider contract: needs and citations, never extension solution labels.
NeedSpanObservation.title: NeedSpanObservation

NormalizedIntent.description: V2 never supplies an unstated Dataset scope or discovery need.
NormalizedIntent.title: NormalizedIntent

quote.description: Literal contiguous substring of this evidence unit content. Copy all spaces, line breaks and hyphens exactly; never join text from separate units.
quote.title: Quote

quote_start.description: Zero-based character offset inside the cited unit content. Omit/null for a unique quote; required only when that exact quote appears more than once.
quote_start.title: Quote Start

RoleRegistry.description: Lossless equivalence groups, sized for a full scan rather than a panel.
RoleRegistry.title: RoleRegistry

SpanObservation.description: Provider-only contract; original quotations are materialized by the server.
SpanObservation.title: SpanObservation

label.description: The exact label of the entry this verdict judges, copied from that entry.
label.title: Label

UserTask.description:
A predefined competency question, corpus-derived task, or declared need.

Requirements link back to user tasks via ``supports_user_tasks`` so that
competency-question coverage can be computed during evaluation (RQ1).
UserTask.title: UserTask

catalogues.description: Extraction excerpt catalogues by catalogue hash, as referenced by role reports.
